subject: Who writes the weapon director's auto-target hold at director+40h, the full predicate of 0071DF70 BSP_WeaponDirector_AcceptsNewTarget, and what 0071D980 issues.
reuses: include/bsp/weapon_director.hpp for kDirectorOffCommandSlots (54h) and kDirectorCommandSlotStride (1Ch), through command_execution.hpp
docs/SESSION_MESSAGE_DISPATCH.md for the 5Ah route that reaches 0071C1E0
docs/COMMAND_EXECUTION.md for 00720850 and the +30h mode field

answer.question: Who writes director+40h, with the call site, the value and when.
answer.result: Three producers; the field is written in the shipped build. The milestone-2n finding is wrong on both halves.

producers.when: once, in the command controller's base constructor; reached for a director from 008363E0 at 00836403 with ECX = this

producers.value: hold - frameDelta, guarded by COMISS at 0071F2FD and JB at 0071F30A
producers.when: every frame, only while the value is >= 0.0f; controller vtable slot +0Ch

producers.instruction: MOVSS dword ptr [ECX+40h],XMM0 with ECX = [EDI+738h] from 00817023
producers.when: the cleartarget arm, selected by CMP EBP,0E08F00h at 00817017

answer.scan: local/scan_off40.py over the shipped PE's executable sections: every MOVSS/MOVSD/MOVUPS store, MOV m32,r32, MOV m32,imm32, MOV m8, FST/FSTP, ADD/SUB/INC/DEC and the matching loads addressing [reg+40h] in both disp8 and disp32 form. 7568 sites, 3884 writes, 794 with a non-stack base. local/scan_dir40.py then filtered those 794 for a +738h displacement in the preceding 100h bytes, which found 00817031 (12 bytes after the fetch) and 00812DA5 (211 bytes, unrelated).

functions.name: BSP_WeaponDirector_AcceptsNewTarget
functions.abi: __thiscall(director) -> bool in AL, RET 0 at 0071DF80, 0071DFC9 and 0071DFCF, body 0071df70-0071dfcf
rules: 0071DF70-0071DF80: hold = [director+40h]; COMISS against 00D7A218 = 0.0f; JBE 0071DF81 continues, so hold > 0.0f returns false
0071DF83-0071DF9E: n = leading occupied slots from +54h in 1Ch steps, stop at the first null command pointer, cap 10
0071DFA7-0071DFC2: for i < n, reject when slot[i].command->vtable[0Ch]() is 1 or 2

calls.native: command->vtable[0Ch] (int category(), the command descriptor's third getter)
calls.role: the only call the gate makes; ECX = slot[i].command, no stack arguments

functions.name: BSP_WeaponDirector_SendOverrideCommand
functions.abi: __thiscall(director)(const CommandClass* command, const SceneCommandTarget* target), RET 8 at 0071d9dd, body 0071d980-0071d9df, SEH handler 00C85108
rules: 0071D995-0071D9A2: XORPS XMM0,XMM0 then COMISS XMM0,[ESI+40h]; JBE skips everything, so the send needs 0.0f > hold
the message flag 0 makes the receiver take the override arm, not the queue arm

calls.role: BSP_GameUnitSetCommandMessage_Construct(&stackMessage, command, target, flag 0), MT_GAMEUNIT_SETCMD type byte 5Ch

functions.name: BSP_CommandControllerBase_Update
functions.abi: __thiscall(controller)(float frameDelta), RET 4 at 0071f3a2, body 0071f290-0071f3a4 inclusive, decoded from disk bytes
functions.coverage: partial: the hold arm 0071F2F8-0071F316 is complete; 0071F290-0071F2F7 and 0071F317-0071F3A4 are summarised from one read and their callees are unread
rules: 0071F2F8-0071F316: COMISS the hold against 00D7A218 = 0.0f; JB skips the x87 subtraction, so a negative value is left alone and everything else becomes hold - frameDelta

calls_unverifiable.why: Ghidra defines no function containing this site, so verify_report_calls.py cannot check it; the site was read with bsp.py disasm-raw

functions.name: BSP_CommandControllerBase_Construct
functions.abi: __thiscall(controller)(void* owner), body 00720180-00720442, SEH handler 00C85357; Ghidra's auto-name CG_array_ctor_helper_00720180 is wrong
functions.coverage: partial: the field stores 007201AB-0072031E including the +40h store; the three CALL tails and everything past 0072031E are unread
fields: +54h array: LEA EAX,[ESI+54h] with stride 1Ch and count 0Ah pushed at 0072020E-00720213

calls.role: the ten-slot array construction helper, after the stride/count push

functions.name: BSP_WeaponDirectorBase_Construct
functions.coverage: partial: only the call that reaches the +40h producer; the rest is docs/WEAPON_DIRECTOR.md's

calls.role: the base-base constructor; ECX is still this (008363FC MOV ESI,ECX, and the PUSH ECX at 008363F5 only reserves a slot)
read the current fire target after arming the hold
BSP_WeaponDirector_SetFireTarget(0, force flag from the previous target test)
BSP_CommandTarget_ResolveObject on director+18Ch, the current command's target
send command state 2 when the cleared target was the current command's

functions.name: BSP_WeaponDirector_ApplyGameUnitMessage
functions.coverage: partial: the vtable[38h] hop at 00721A93 and the message+20h branch 00721B2E-00721B87

calls.role: the session-side caller docs/WEAPON_DIRECTOR.md recorded as unread; EDX loaded at 00721A8F, message pushed at 00721A92
decode the command target record out of the message (flag non-zero arm)
decode the command ordinal at message+21h into its singleton
decode the command target record (flag zero arm)
decode the command ordinal (flag zero arm)
message+20h zero: BSP_WeaponDirector_SetOverrideCommand(command, target). This is what 0071D980 reaches.

functions.name: BSP_WeaponDirector_IssueCommand
functions.coverage: partial: read only as the contrast to 0071D980; the vtable[140h] and 00A2BD90 arms are unread

calls.role: the same message builder with flag 1, so the receiver takes the queue arm

no_ghidra_function.name: BSP_CommandControllerBase_Update
no_ghidra_function.note: inclusive end: RET 4 at 0071F3A2 occupies 0071F3A2-0071F3A4, then INT3 padding to 0071F3AF. Ghidra's FUN_0071F110 ends at 0071F14C and FUN_0071F3B0 starts after the padding, so 0071F14D-0071F3AF is undefined code holding at least five routines.

data.role: the gate's threshold, read by 0071DF75 and 0071F2FD

corrections.was: 0071DF70 requires the float at [director+40h] to be greater than 0.0f
corrections.is: 0071DF70 requires the float to be at most 0.0f; greater than 0.0f is the rejection
corrections.evidence: 0071DF7C JBE 0071DF81 jumps to the slot scan; the fall-through at 0071DF7E is XOR AL,AL; RET. COMISS sets CF or ZF for below, equal and unordered, so only a strictly greater value falls through.

corrections.was: director+40h has no writer in this process, no recovered producer anywhere
corrections.evidence: the producer table above, found with local/scan_off40.py and local/scan_dir40.py over the shipped PE

corrections.was: +40h is not written by the director constructor 008366D0
corrections.is: true of 008366D0, but its base 008363E0 calls 00720180 at 00836403 and that routine writes the field
corrections.evidence: 008363FC MOV ESI,ECX leaves ECX = this across the PUSH ECX slot reservation, so 00720180 runs on the director

corrections.was: Who calls 0071C1E0 from the session side is a contract: unread. Ghidra records no caller.
corrections.is: 00721A40 BSP_WeaponDirector_ApplyGameUnitMessage calls it at 00721A93 as director->vtable[38h](message), reached from 00780120's IsA(59h) arm
corrections.evidence: 00721A8B MOV ECX,[EDI]; 00721A8D MOV EAX,[ECX]; 00721A8F MOV EDX,[EAX+38h]; 00721A92 PUSH ESI; 00721A93 CALL EDX. Already recorded in docs/SESSION_MESSAGE_DISPATCH.md lines 246 and 321.

corrections.was: 00720CD0 partial: the slot loop and the command issue are read; 00720850 and the command descriptor 00E08F60 are unread
corrections.is: 00720850 has been read since by packet cc2_director_commands and is documented in docs/COMMAND_EXECUTION.md, including its name recovered from the trace literal
corrections.evidence: the BSP reconstruction plate comment on 00720850 and docs/COMMAND_EXECUTION.md lines 33-54

contracts: 009F5DA0 BSP_WeaponDirector_AutoTargetTick and the rest of docs/BOT_FIRE_TARGET.md belong to packet cc2_bot_fire_target; read here, not edited.
009F4D10 BSP_ShipAi_PublishOrderSlot was read only to rule it out as a +40h producer; it belongs to another orchestrator's ship-AI packets.
00720850, 00720CD0, 0071E6C0, 0071E7F0, 008358D0 and the +30h mode field belong to docs/COMMAND_EXECUTION.md (packet cc2_director_commands).
00780120 and the 5Ah delivery ladder belong to docs/SESSION_MESSAGE_DISPATCH.md.
